name: complex-incident-timeline
description: Test that the agent can reconstruct incidents from event logs and compute durations, severity, and root causes.
task: read events.csv and create incident_summary.txt with one line per incident in the format 'incident_id: duration_minutes, services, max_severity, root_cause, event_count', sorted by duration descending then incident_id ascending. duration_minutes is the whole number of minutes between the earliest and latest event timestamp for that incident. services is the number of distinct services. max_severity uses the order CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW > INFO. root_cause is the event_id of the event whose event_type is 'root_cause', or 'unknown' if none. event_count is the number of events for that incident.
